from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline,FeatureUnion
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score,confusion_matrix
rows = [{'text':text,'category':category} for category,texts in TEXTS_BY_CATEGORY.items() for text in texts]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test = train_test_split(df['text'],df['category'],test_size=.25,random_state=4,stratify=df['category'])
model_v1 = Pipeline([('tfidf',TfidfVectorizer()),('classifier',LinearSVC(random_state=42))]).fit(X_train,y_train)
model_v2 = Pipeline([
    ('features',FeatureUnion([
        ('word',TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2),sublinear_tf=True)),
        ('char',TfidfVectorizer(analyzer='char_wb',ngram_range=(3,5),sublinear_tf=True))])),
    ('classifier',LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000,C=8,random_state=42))
]).fit(X_train,y_train)
accuracy_v1 = accuracy_score(y_test,model_v1.predict(X_test))
accuracy_v2 = accuracy_score(y_test,model_v2.predict(X_test))
print('v1:',accuracy_v1,'ошибок:',int((model_v1.predict(X_test)!=y_test).sum()))
print('v2:',accuracy_v2,'ошибок:',int((model_v2.predict(X_test)!=y_test).sum()))
for text in ['интернет не работает','не работает портал','срочно помогите']:
    probabilities = model_v2.predict_proba([text])[0]
    best = int(probabilities.argmax())
    print(text,str(model_v2.classes_[best]),round(float(probabilities[best]),4),'manual_review' if probabilities[best]<.60 else 'accepted')
